scope: Python SDK, canonical AgentClient/ADK session views and runtime path discovery
changes: Blender discovery uses explicit argument, APHRODY_BLENDER_BIN, then PATH; fixed host directories and version lists removed.
Invalid explicit executable selections fail instead of choosing a different installed runtime.
Runtime state-directory candidates use the native executable suffix, including .exe on Windows.
Explicit executable paths expand the user home and retain paths containing spaces.
SessionDB resolves APHRODY_HOME at construction; DEFAULT_DB_PATH remains a compatibility snapshot for existing imports.
ADK sessions use canonical AgentClient transport and native session persistence; no second runtime installer, credential store or database.

ruff.command: uv run --locked --no-sync ruff check packages/aphrody/src/aphrody packages/aphrody/tests

checks.pathTests: Temporary synthetic executable/database paths; Linux, Darwin and Windows suffix policy; relocation and spaces; not native execution on all platforms.

limits: Full Windows/macOS native runtime, Blender execution, installation and wheels have not been qualified.
Existing protected stores remain in their original locations; no automatic data migration.
ADK model/reset and other missing owner RPCs remain explicit unsupported capabilities.
ADK module notices retain AGPL-3.0-only provenance; package still declares Apache-2.0, so a new mixed-license wheel is not qualified.
YOLO/Rust/UI work remains stopped at the owner's request; this receipt does not qualify those repositories or interfaces.
Legacy dedicated RG deployment scripts are outside this SDK batch and belong to their canonical IECODE owner.
